52369.body:
#### PR description:

This PR backports https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50911 as requested in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/47050#issuecomment-6069544996 . To make the backport more straightforward the following additional cleanup PRs are included
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/47914
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49134
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49430

The diffs of these 3 PRs applied cleanly on 14_0_X (whereas the #50911 did not). Therefore I'd suggest to focus the review effort to compare the last commit of this PR to the content of #50911.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2482

#### PR validation:

Code compiles.

52392.author: eyigitba
52392.body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds some missing keep statements to `L1Trigger_EventContent` which are required for L1 scouting reduced event content MC requests in Phase2Spring24 campaign. 

Most of these keep statements already exist in the releases that come after this one. However, a full backport of the keep statements from newer releases is not possible as it can end up crashing the emulation due to buggy producers. Therefore I only added the collections that already exist in the default `SimL1Emulator` sequence in 140X releases and that does not crash the workflows. 

In principle, this PR only affects data/MC produced with 140X releases and doesn't need to be ported to another release. But if you prefer to have these changes propagated I can also do that. 


#### PR validation:

Validated by rerunning step2 and step3 `cmsDriver` commands from Phase2Spring24 MC campaign and making sure that the added collections now appear in the final event content and the necessary L1 scouting re-emulation jobs can run on this final root file.

52392.title: [14_0_X] [L1T] Adding missing keep statements to L1T event content definitions

52417.author: Gianco99
52417.body:
#### PR description:

[#49414](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49414) added `get_hscp_particle_names_from_pdt`, which only looks for relative PDT paths under `$CMSSW_RELEASE_BASE/external/$SCRAM_ARCH/data`. That's fine for the cms-data tables, but the default `pythiaparticle.tbl` lives in `src`, so HSCP fragments that don't set `pdtFile` crash at config time with the error below:

```
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/cvmfs/cms.cern.ch/el9_amd64_gcc12/cms/cmssw/CMSSW_14_0_25/external/el9_amd64_gcc12/data/SimGeneral/HepPDTESSource/data/pythiaparticle.tbl'
```

We found this during [2024 AMSB chargino production](https://gitlab.cern.ch/cms-exo-mci/EXO-MCsampleRequests/-/merge_requests/477) (CMSSW_14_0_25).

The proposed fix looks the file up through `CMSSW_SEARCH_PATH`, the same way `FileInPath` does, and keeps the old location as a fallback, so nothing that worked before changes.

#### PR validation:

Tested in `CMSSW_14_0_25` with this branch:

```
python3 -c "from SimG4Core.CustomPhysics.Exotica_HSCP_SIM_cfi import get_hscp_particle_names_from_pdt as f; print(f('stau','SimGeneral/HepPDTESSource/data/pythiaparticle.tbl'))"
```

Before the fix this gives the `FileNotFoundError` above. After the fix it prints `['~tau_1-', '~tau_1+', '~tau_2-', '~tau_2+']`. Tables that already worked, like the ones in cms-data, give the same result as before.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Backport of [#52416](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52416), needed for RunIII2024Summer24 HSCP production (CMSSW_14_0_25).
52417.title: [14_0_X] Exotica_HSCP_SIM_cfi: fix PDT file lookup for relative paths
